integrity: One mathematically proved polynomial identity; self-contained proof and executable independent enumeration of finite cases accompany this result. No independently audited claims or priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem is confined to labeled rook graphs K_3 Cartesian K_n with n >= 3 and inclusion-minimal total dominating sets. Finite computational comparisons cover n=3..7, not all orders. No assertion of universal publication priority or independent validation.
title: Minimal total-domination polynomial of three-row rook graphs and unbounded cardinality gaps
